text: SANA-Video 2.0 is a hybrid video diffusion transformer at 5B and 14B scales. Hybrid Linear–Softmax Attention combines gated linear attention for O(N)-dominated mixing with periodic gated-softmax anchors at a 3:1 ratio, restoring full-rank token interactions that pure linear attention lacks. Block Attention Residuals (AttnRes) route completed block summaries into later linear layers and are reported to boost deep-layer effective rank by about 12%. Reduced-resolution proxy studies establish 25% softmax as the quality–efficiency trade-off (consistent with the 3:1 layout). With 40-step sampling, the paper reports a VBench score of 84.30 in 13.2s at 480p on a single H100. [@chk-2de70a6c333fc1bc8f50367c]
